story:
    id: "99.1"
    title: Document Summary On Demand
    as_a: Claude User
    i_want: Claude to give me a short summary of a Google Doc when I ask
    so_that: I can get a quick gist without downloading the document or copy pasting large sections of it into another app
    status: PLANNED
    acceptance_criteria:
        - id: AC-1
          description: When the Claude User asks Claude to summarize a shared Google Doc, Claude must return a paragraph-length summary in the conversation.
          steps:
            - given:
                - The Claude User has shared a Google Doc with Claude
            - when:
                - The Claude User asks Claude to summarize that Google Doc
            - then:
                - Claude returns a paragraph-length summary of the document in the conversation
        - id: AC-2
          description: When the Claude User asks Claude to summarize a document they have not shared, Claude must return a message explaining the document needs to be shared first.
          steps:
            - given:
                - The Claude User has not shared the requested Google Doc with Claude
            - when:
                - The Claude User asks Claude to summarize that Google Doc
            - then:
                - Claude returns a clear message explaining the Claude User needs to share the document first
        - id: AC-3
          description: When the document is too long for Claude to summarize confidently, Claude must return a message stating it only read part of the document.
          steps:
            - given:
                - The Claude User has shared a Google Doc that is too long to summarize confidently
            - when:
                - The Claude User asks Claude to summarize that Google Doc
            - then:
                - Claude returns a message telling the Claude User it only read part of the document
